response.sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings WHERE points >= 6.0 GROUP BY raceId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg FROM per_race) SELECT p.raceId, p.avg_points, p.avg_wins, p.avg_wins - o.overall_avg AS diff FROM per_race p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (p.avg_wins - o.overall_avg) IS NULL, p.avg_wins - o.overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Races with no constructor standings entries having points >= 6.0 do not appear, and the overall average is taken over the per-race average wins of the races that do appear. Ties in the difference are ordered arbitrarily.
